speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; tell me, how many days old are you?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Volvulus. The presentation of bilious vomiting within six hours of birth is a surgical emergency; do not wait for further questioning, as immediate surgical consultation is required.
